EmailTemplate.description: FQS Gift Acknowledgement — Lightning HTML shell template for the automated post-gift acknowledgement sent by the FQS_Gift_Acknowledgement flow. Acknowledgement is the universal "we got your gift, thanks, here is your deduction info" touch — every donor with a valid email receives one. Placeholder copy is intentional; marketing should replace body text before go-live. Merge fields reference the related GiftTransaction record passed by the flow. Stewardship (relationship-deepening follow-up) is handled separately by the FQS_Stewardship_Response flow + FQS_Stewardship_Response_Standard template.
EmailTemplate.name: FQS Gift Acknowledgement
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your gift!
